_comment: PDK version pin for the sky130-gcedram design sources (issue #14).
Same pin as sim/leakage/pdk.json -- reused unmodified so the schematic
and its derived netlist resolve against the exact same shipped model
was measured against. No reason for design/ to diverge from sim/'s pin.
family            sky130 PDK family (via volare -- a stock open_pdks
variant           sky130 flavor directory to use (A/B differ in metal
stack only; irrelevant to schematic capture/netlisting)
open_pdks_commit  the volare version hash design/gain_cell_2t.sch and
its derived netlist are pinned against
default_pdk_root  fallback PDK_ROOT if $PDK_ROOT is unset
xschem_pdk_rc     the PDK's own xschemrc, sourced by design/xschemrc
